_note: Short labels for the 20 risk factors. Each code belongs to one group, so an agent shows each group once. kind: 'access' (can do) or 'activity' (did). level: 'act' (Critical), 'watch' (Warning), 'info' (Info).

groups.headline: Sandbox escape
groups.decision: Stop the agent. Check files outside the project.

groups.headline: Config tampering
groups.decision: Stop the agent. Restore its config.

groups.headline: Credential access
groups.why: Read a file with keys, tokens or passwords.
groups.decision: Stop the agent if not expected. Rotate the credentials.

groups.headline: Persistence
groups.decision: Stop the agent. Remove the startup entry.

groups.headline: Network scanning
groups.why: Scanned hosts or ports on the network.
groups.decision: Stop the agent if the scan was not requested.

groups.headline: Cloud metadata access
groups.why: Queried the cloud metadata service for credentials.
groups.decision: Stop the agent. Review the instance role.

groups.headline: Suspicious connection
groups.why: Connected to an unexpected or private address.
groups.decision: Check the destination. Block it if unknown.

groups.headline: Process spike
groups.why: Started many processes in a short time.

groups.headline: Open port
groups.why: Listens for connections from the network.
groups.decision: Close the port if not required.

groups.headline: Unapproved agent
groups.why: Blocked by policy on this host.
groups.decision: Stop the agent or update the policy.

groups.headline: Watchlist match
groups.why: Can reach or touched a watched path.

groups.headline: Credential exposure
groups.why: Can read credentials and has network access.

groups.headline: Full system access
groups.why: Can run commands and write outside the project.
groups.decision: Expected for coding agents. Restrict if untrusted.

groups.headline: Config drift
groups.why: Uses access its config does not declare.
groups.decision: Update the config or stop the agent.
